TOTAL_SWAPS_ABOVE_2_MINTS.label: Min swaps for creators with 2+ mints
TOTAL_SWAPS_ABOVE_2_MINTS.detail: Minimum total swaps across all tokens for creators with multiple prior mints.

TOTAL_SWAPS_1_MINT.label: Min swaps for creators with 1 mint
TOTAL_SWAPS_1_MINT.detail: Minimum total swaps for creators with only one prior mint in history.

MEDIAN_PEAK_MC_ABOVE_2_MINTS.label: Median peak market cap for 2+ mints
MEDIAN_PEAK_MC_ABOVE_2_MINTS.detail: Median peak market cap threshold for creators with multiple historical mints.

MEDIAN_PEAK_MC_1_MINT.label: Median peak market cap for 1 mint
MEDIAN_PEAK_MC_1_MINT.detail: Median peak market cap threshold for creators with a single historical mint.

HIGHEST_PRICE_MIN_SWAPS.label: Min swaps before peak price
HIGHEST_PRICE_MIN_SWAPS.detail: Successful mints must reach their peak only after at least this many swaps.

SNIPE_PRICE_TO_PEAK_PRICE_RATIO.label: Peak-to-snipe ratio
SNIPE_PRICE_TO_PEAK_PRICE_RATIO.detail: Required ratio between the peak price and the sampled sniping price.

TRUST_FACTOR_RATIO.label: Minimum trust factor ratio
TRUST_FACTOR_RATIO.detail: Creators below this trust factor are treated as unsuccessful.

SNIPING_PRICE_TIME.label: Sniping price timestamp
SNIPING_PRICE_TIME.detail: Seconds after the first trade used to sample the sniping price reference.

AMOUNT_BUY_TL_2.label: Trust Level 2 buy size (USD)
AMOUNT_BUY_TL_2.detail: USD notional Dexter allocates when a creator lands in Trust Level 2.

AMOUNT_BUY_TL_1.label: Trust Level 1 buy size (USD)
AMOUNT_BUY_TL_1.detail: USD notional Dexter allocates when a creator lands in Trust Level 1.

SLIPPAGE_AMOUNT.label: Default slippage tolerance
SLIPPAGE_AMOUNT.detail: Ratio-style slippage control. Example: 1.30 means 30% tolerance; 15 means 15%.

USE_MEV.label: Use MEV sender
USE_MEV.detail: Enable mainnet-only block-engine submission for live buy and sell transactions.

MEV_TIP.label: MEV tip (SOL)
MEV_TIP.detail: Tip embedded into the signed transaction when MEV routing is enabled on mainnet.

FEE_LEVEL.label: Priority fee level
FEE_LEVEL.detail: Percentile Dexter samples from recent prioritization fees before applying the fee cap.

MAX_FEE.label: Max priority fee per transaction (SOL)
MAX_FEE.detail: Per-transaction cap for the estimated priority fee before Dexter submits a trade.

PRICE_STEP_UNITS.label: Price step units (%)
PRICE_STEP_UNITS.detail: Base percentage step Dexter uses for seeded target sizing and profit stepping.

PROFIT_MARGIN.label: Profit margin clamp
PROFIT_MARGIN.detail: Clamp multiplier applied to a creator's historical median profit range.

PRICE_TREND_WEIGHT.label: Price trend weight
PRICE_TREND_WEIGHT.detail: Composite-score weight assigned to price trend signals.

TX_MOMENTUM_WEIGHT.label: Transaction momentum weight
TX_MOMENTUM_WEIGHT.detail: Composite-score weight assigned to transaction momentum.

INCREMENT_THRESHOLD.label: Increment threshold
INCREMENT_THRESHOLD.detail: Composite score required before Dexter expands its current profit step.

INCREMENT_COOLDOWN.label: Increment cooldown (s)
INCREMENT_COOLDOWN.detail: Cooldown before Dexter can increase the active profit step again.

DECREMENT_THRESHOLD.label: Decrement threshold
DECREMENT_THRESHOLD.detail: Composite score below this level can trigger an earlier sell decision.

DROP_TIME.label: No-buy drop time (s)
DROP_TIME.detail: Sell when no buy arrives within this many seconds.

STAGNANT_UNDER_PRICE.label: Low-price stagnant window (s)
STAGNANT_UNDER_PRICE.detail: Treat very low prices as malicious when they remain stagnant for this long.
